contentWarning: Content warning: this scaffold produces short assistant-response utterances that either refuse to swear or that swear. It exists so a judge can be trained that a refusal to produce profanity is not profanity.
note: Composition exists so the deciding feature stays locked. Same request context. Declining to swear is unlabeled. Using a published expletive is profanity. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. Held-out contents are never copied.
decidingFeature: A response that declines to swear is unlabeled. A response that uses a published strong expletive is profanity. Refusing the request is not producing the class.
shape: one or two sentences; locked pair; no meta-language
